segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Let's keep it in English mostly - und kurz auf Deutsch, wenn es einfacher ist.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Gerne. Our onboarding takes 6 weeks, and the reporting is manual - das ist der eigentliche Schmerz.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Verstanden. What would faster onboarding be worth in numbers?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Maybe 20 percent of capacity. The process would be procurement then signature by end of November.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Then let's book the technical session - does Thursday work?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Donnerstag passt. Looking forward to it.
